revenueCatDashboardSteps: 1. Create a RevenueCat project for ProteinQuest.
2. Add iOS app (bundle com.proteinquest.app) with App Store Connect shared secret / StoreKit 2.
3. Add Android app (package com.proteinquest.app) with Google Play service credentials JSON.
5. Create products pro_weekly and pro_yearly linked to store product IDs above.
6. Create offering 'default' with packages $rc_weekly → pro_weekly and $rc_annual → pro_yearly.
7. Copy public SDK keys to EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_IOS_KEY and EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_ANDROID_KEY.
8. (Recommended) Configure RevenueCat → Supabase webhook to set profiles.is_premium server-side.
